title: A Trader Up from Forgehold
sceneText:
Somebody knocks at dusk. A trader up from Forgehold, who has travelled into the dark and asks whether he might have a bed for the night.

The custom around here is that he gets one.

variants.stay_head:
Martha cooked for one more without asking you.

He sat in the kitchen a while in the evening and talked about the road. Six days out of Forgehold, across three duchies.
variants.stay_tail: When he left in the morning he had put a small packet by for Martha. Salt. The fine salt they have in Forgehold. She took it.

effects.logEntry: You put up a trader from Forgehold for the night.
A trader from Forgehold asked for a bed, and you said it was not convenient.

choices.resultText:
You said it was not convenient at the estate just now.

He did not argue. He thanked you and went. He set off in the direction of Valehold, which is over an hour further on, and it was already dark.

Martha stood in the kitchen doorway and watched him go. She said nothing.

In the morning you heard that he had been put up at Millridge.
